totp.description: 6-digit TOTP code if MFA is enabled

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

retentionDays.description: Days the platform keeps tenant data by default

qrCodeDataUrl.description: Data URL (image/png) for the QR code

token.description: 6-digit TOTP code from the authenticator app

performedProcedureStepId.description: DICOM PerformedProcedureStepID (0040,0253). Stable across N-CREATE / N-SET.

accessionNumber.description: AccessionNumber from the original MWL entry (joins MPPS to ORM/MWL).

outcome.description: "new" if first time we see this PPS, "update" otherwise

mwlEntryId.description: mwl_entry.id matched by accession_number, null otherwise

reportStudyId.description: report_study.id matched by study_iuid, null otherwise

studyInstanceUid.description: DICOM StudyInstanceUID of the study to ingest from Orthanc

hospitalId.description: Optional explicit hospital scope (required for multi-hospital users).

professionalId.description: Optional professional override (admins/coordinators only). Defaults to the actor.

comments.description: Optional reviewer comments stored in audit log

eventType.description: Tipo de evento (ej: report_start, report_view_img, report_finalize, etc.)

eventPayload.description: Payload del evento (estructura flexible y serializable)

hospitalId.description: Optional explicit hospital scope. Required for users that belong to several hospitals.

pdfUrl.description: Short-lived signed URL to the rendered PDF

drawingBase64.description: Base64-encoded PNG of the drawn signature

displayedName.description: Override the displayed name (defaults to the professional record).

collegiate.description: Override the collegiate number (defaults to the professional record).

findings.description: Plain-text findings the radiologist already wrote

acceptConsent.description: Set true on the first call to record the consent timestamp on the user. Subsequent calls do not need it.

text.description: Markdown / plain-text draft from the upstream

reviewerProfessionalId.description: Optional second professional that will perform a verification read.

avgMinutesToSign.description: Average minutes from study creation to report signed

avgMinutesSignToSent.description: Average minutes from signed to sent

slaMinutes.description: SLA threshold in minutes used to compute overSla

restricted.description: Enable or disable processing restriction (RGPD art. 18)
